name: Standing Resistance Band Chest Press

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: VA MOVE! Resistance Band Physical Activity Guides

steps: Anchor a resistance band at chest height behind you, or loop it firmly across your upper back.
Hold the band handles or ends at chest level with your elbows bent and palms facing downward.
Step forward into a staggered stance with one foot ahead for stability, feeling light initial tension on the band.
Press both hands straight forward, extending your arms and squeezing your chest muscles at the peak.
Slowly reverse the movement, controlling the band's pull back to your chest without letting your elbows yank backward.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulders pressed down away from your ears throughout the movement.
Maintain an upright torso and braced core; do not lean backward as the band pulls you.
Exhale as you press forward and inhale as you return.

sources.attribution: VA MOVE! Physical Therapy Band Guides
